title: Mamak vs Haze
lead: Can you keep your customers drinking teh tarik while fighting off haze?
h2: Your arm gets tired easily and needs to take breaks.
smP: Smokers worsen the haze. Fan it away and mask him after to stop him from lighting up again.

quit.one: Your helper quit. You couldn't pay him :(
quit.other: {n} helpers quit. You couldn't pay them :(

efan.name: Electric fan
efan.desc: Stronger than your hand but needs time to recharge.

staff.name: Hire a helper
staff.desc: Walks around fanning tables. You pay RM30 wages per night.

mask.name: Face masks
mask.desc: 5 in a box. Drag one onto customer for temp extra protection.

purif.name: Air purifier
purif.desc: Cleans the air at one table.

roti.name: Roti canai
roti.desc: Sells for RM3. Takes a while to finish.

filter.name: Purifier filter
filter.desc: Filters get dirty after 2 nights and needs replacement.

sign.name: No smoking sign
sign.desc: Drag it onto a smoker to make him stop.

tv.name: Football TV
tv.desc: People stay calmer when there's a match on.

cat.name: Oyen
cat.desc: When Oyen sits with a customer, they stay longer.
